articles.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
articles.snippet: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.

articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.snippet: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: Calpers pulls back from big tech as AI jitters deepen neocloud sell-off
articles.snippet: California’s pension fund shifts toward private equity as investors question tech valuations and the payoff from soaring AI spending.

articles.title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
articles.snippet: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

articles.title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
articles.snippet: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.
